title: Story premise EDU117: The Scissor Platform Changes Shape
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: Will widening the feet make the platform taller? Takeaway/theme: In an ideal scissor linkage, horizontal spread and vertical height are geometrically linked.
description: A model platform wants to rise while its base stays on a rail, but pulling the lower joints apart lowers it instead. A constrained X-linkage and dimension overlay reveal the geometric relationship.
